Metadata.title: Academy of Wanderings
Metadata.description: Academy of Wanderings is a creative space in Saint Petersburg for events, festivals, performances, workshops and cultural projects.

Hero.title: Academy of Wanderings
Hero.description: We create festivals, performances, concerts and children’s programs — events where history, music and craft become a living adventure.

team.title: Academy team
team.quote: “A wanderer is a free wind, finding its path at the crossroads of a thousand roads.”

achievements.title: Our achievements

stats.participants: Participants in Academy of Wanderings projects

achievements.intro: Over the years, with support from the Saint Petersburg Committee for Culture, the Academy has produced festivals, competitions, concerts, performances and charitable programs.
achievements.pandemicNote: The Academy joined the list of socially oriented non-profit organizations and received numerous letters of thanks. During the pandemic, the team quickly adopted digital tools, developed online event methods and preserved a high level of project quality.
